rules: Inspect the repository before changing files. Understand existing structure, registries, and conventions.
Prefer small, correct, reviewable changes over broad rewrites.
Do not invent requirements. If the request is ambiguous, ask a clarifying question or record an explicit assumption.
For non-trivial coding, create or update a spec before implementation.
Keep plans concrete: files to touch, steps to take, and checks to run.
Run validation when possible, especially `npm run validate` for repository structure changes.
Keep external attribution clean. Do not vendor third-party code, prompts, or docs.
Do not place secrets or private credentials in repository memory or examples.
Run `npm run validate:traceability` after adding, renaming, or removing a command/skill/template.

slashCommands.name: spec
slashCommands.prompt: Read {{ ~/vibe-coding-os/commands/vibe-spec.md }} and follow its steps to create a system specification for the current task.

slashCommands.name: plan
slashCommands.description: Create an implementation plan from a spec
slashCommands.prompt: Read {{ ~/vibe-coding-os/commands/vibe-plan.md }} and follow its steps to create a detailed plan with files, steps, and verification checks.

slashCommands.name: implement
slashCommands.description: Implement from a plan or spec
slashCommands.prompt: Read {{ ~/vibe-coding-os/commands/vibe-implement.md }} and implement the planned changes. Apply what-before-how approach.

slashCommands.name: review
slashCommands.prompt: Read {{ ~/vibe-coding-os/commands/vibe-review.md }} and review the changes. Check correctness, scope, attribution, and tests.

slashCommands.name: memory
slashCommands.description: Save session context to durable memory
slashCommands.prompt: Read {{ ~/vibe-coding-os/commands/vibe-memory.md }} and save key decisions, rationale, and open questions from this session.

slashCommands.name: validate
slashCommands.prompt: Run `npm run validate` and report any failures.
